{{Top}}
[[File:HockCrops.jpg|thumb|right|210px|[[Hock Malsuum]] picking vegetables in the field]]
{{Quote|You seemed to take it well enough. Making me promise to kill you."''<br />''"Under certain circumstances. Not just because I insist you eat your vegetables.|[[Ben Skywalker]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|his father]], having a humorous conversation|<ref name="Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref>}}
'''Vegetables''' were a type of [[Foodstuff|food]] grown on a [[Plant/Legends|plant]]. Some people liked to grow their own vegetables in a garden.<ref name="The Swarm">''[[Galaxy of Fear: The Swarm]]''</ref><ref name="Changing">''[[Jedi Quest: The Changing of the Guard]]''</ref> They could also be grown in hydroponic gardens. They were sometimes served alongside meat<ref name="Dawn">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref><ref name="Skyborn">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Skyborn]]''</ref> or sauce.<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref> They could also be part of other dishes, such as turnovers<ref name="Legacy">''[[Legacy of the Jedi]]''</ref> stew,<ref name="Wild Space">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref> and crepes.<ref name="Taster's Choice">{{StoryCite|story=Taster's Choice: The Tale of Jabba's Chef|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref> Some forms of vegetables were known as root vegetables.<ref name="Dawn" /> and soup.<ref name="Ascension" />

Many children did not like vegetables<ref name="YDR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref><ref name="Backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref> and preferred unhealthy food.

{{Food-stub}}
